# Asset marks

Crypto SVGs: https://github.com/spothq/cryptocurrency-icons (CC0-1.0; full terms in CC0.txt).
Company SVGs: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/12.0.0/icons (CC0-1.0), NVIDIA from develop. Company marks are placed on a white backing for legibility.

Marks identify instruments, not endorsement. Trademark rights remain with their owners.
Both website and iOS bundle the same reviewed vector geometry locally. No third-party logo request or credential is required.
Unknown assets retain a neutral ticker placeholder. US stocks are resolved separately from crypto; exchange contracts and similarly named tokens are not treated as company shares.

Bundled crypto: BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, USDT, USDC.
Bundled stocks: AAPL, TSLA, NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL/GOOG, AMZN, META.

XMAX: unmodified official favicon downloaded from https://xmax.com/themes/simpleboot3/public/assets/images/favicon.png on 2026-11-07, with issuer identity confirmed on https://xmax.com/. The source PNG is bundled without recoloring.
